decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sudden multi-sample shift near index 490 in the overlapping window [485,664], involving coordinated N/E drop and U rise; (2) a longer interval starting at index 605 where vertical motion diverges from horizontal trends, hinting at superposed or opposing behavior. Both warrant closer inspection for platform-like or offset morphology.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 490–493, with U showing a concurrent rise; appears as a possible abrupt offset or platform onset, not fully resolved in coarse view but distinct from surrounding noise.

Extended region (605–625) where N/E/U all trend downward together, then U shows a sharp rebound while N/E continue descending—suggesting superposed motion: possible opposing return in U against ongoing drift in horizontal components.
